context: Atelier is shipped and current at v0.37.0 on npm with the University pack bundled into the @a-company/atelier tarball (verified live: 55 university files + paradigm.universityPack pointer). Paradigm symbols now carry FULL per-component aspect coverage — 305 aspects across all 137 components (was 0), every component has >=1, drift clean on 485 anchors, all compliance passing. Working tree clean, 0 unpushed commits. Nothing outstanding; this is a natural stopping point.
plan: Complete. Releases v0.34.0–v0.37.0 published to npm (atelier 0.37.0, -mcp 0.27.2, -studio 0.28.0, -schema 0.28.0, -types 0.31.0, -video 0.1.0). Claude plugin (ascend42/a-atelier-plugin) live with corrected launch + 61 tools. Future content edits: author in .paradigm/university/, bump CLI version, pnpm release (prepublish auto-bundles). Deferred/optional follow-ups: Playwright e2e (spec in .paradigm/specs/v1-testing-strategy.md), pixel-snapshot tests, the @a-company/atelier-mcp peerDependency cleanup, extract-inline-app already done.
decisions: Studio v1 = promote the existing atelier studio CLI app to creator-grade, not build a new app (cold review found the app already existed)
LLM<->human loop uses an in-memory WS bridge (DocumentStore.onChange + applyMutation), not file-watch — preserves selection/undo/scroll

Atelier owns NO image generation — generation is chat-orchestrated (user runs Higgsfield CLI externally); Atelier ingests via atelier_import_images. Reverted in-Atelier generator (cherry-pick e87d29e to restore)
PNG export uses @napi-rs/canvas (prebuilt) not node-canvas, so it works on a plain npm install
Paradigm aspect convention is per-component (>=1 each, more for multi-responsibility) — stricter than generic 'multi-site only'; defer to project owner's rule
University pack bundled into the main @a-company/atelier package (versioned in lockstep with the engine), source of truth stays .paradigm/university/, copy generated at prepublish + gitignored
